title: A broken AI door answers 'not configured' instead of spending the environment key; a disabled provider's key is revoked on every host; the assistant never saves a cut, errored or empty stream as an answer; rewrite, provider save and the comment fence keep their limits (the question generator was removed 10/10/2026)
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd` with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a scratch Postgres.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/llm-door.js modelForChain; lib/llm-store.js lookupDoor; lib/llm-push.js pushModelKeys; assistant/model.js readEvent; apps/tracy-host/src/app.js modelKeysRoute
selectors.test: apps/tracy-web/test/llm-store.test.mjs, llm-push.test.mjs, assistant.test.mjs, brief-door-port.test.mjs, brief-rewrite.test.mjs, ops-llm.test.mjs; apps/tracy-host/test/model-keys.test.mjs; packages/ui/tracy-chat-input/test/comment-turn-write-line.test.mjs

fence: lookupDoor tells an unassigned door (environment may answer) from an assigned one that cannot answer (null plus a warning); an empty book is pushed as an explicit clear; the stream reader needs a finish reason; a person-written write: line is indented so the comment fence never reads it as a target. Throwaway Postgres and local doubles, no network.

tests: an assigned door whose provider is switched off answers null, not the environment
an assigned door whose key will not open answers null, not the environment
with a database, a door nobody assigned refuses even when the environment has a model
a stream that hits the token cap is TRUNCATED, not a finished answer
a stream that just stops, with no finish reason and no [DONE], is TRUNCATED
a provider error frame inside the stream is a failure
POST /api/assistant/turns: a model that stops mid-answer or says nothing ends in an error frame, never done
pushModelKeys sends every dsh host, and an EMPTY book is an explicit clear
an explicit clear empties the refs block
an assigned agent door narrows the push
saving without a name or address leaves them as they were
a rewrite cannot collapse a long text to a word or two
quotes the owner wrote are kept; only a wrapping pair is stripped
every write to the book leaves a line of history
